description: Introducing the 32" Kent Big League cruiser, designed specifically for big and tall riders who are 6'0"+ and up to 350lbs. With a sturdy, custom aluminum frame and steel fork, this bike is lightweight and just as strong as its rider. The massive 32" cruiser tires provide a smooth ride along with the single speed drivetrain. The coaster brakes are easy to use and provide substantial stopping power. Equipped with features to make bike guys more comfortable, the Big League also comes stock with a deluxe oversized comfort saddle, quick release seat post for rapid height adjustment, and oversized grips for ultimate comfort during your ride. The angle adjustable super wide handlebar makes navigation easy for guys with large wingspans, and the front & rear fenders will keep you clean after rolling through a puddle. The lightweight alloy wheels offer a smooth and nimble ride while also providing rust resistance. The Kent Big League Cruiser Bike is the only bike specifically made for big and tall riders, so you can trust that it's been designed with your comfort and safety in mind. Don't let your height hold you back from the joy of cycling!
